title: VitaFit cloud API before 2026-10-30 contained a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated…
description: VitaFit cloud API versions before 2026-10-30 have a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. Authenticated attackers can upload SVG images containing malicious JavaScript to a shared storage bucket. The application does not properly restrict script execution or force downloads for SVG content, allowing the JavaScript to execute when a victim opens the file directly in a browser.
